---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Ensure Docker is installed and running
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Docker not found. Installing Docker CE..."
    # Detect OS (Debian/Ubuntu based)
    if [[ -f /etc/os-release ]]; then
        . /etc/os-release
        if [[ "$ID" =~ ^(debian|ubuntu)$ ]]; then
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y \
                ca-certificates curl gnupg lsb-release
            sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
            curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/${ID}/gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
            echo \
              "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/${ID} \
              $(lsb_release -cs) stable" | \
              sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
        else
            echo "Unsupported Linux distribution. Please install Docker manually."
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "/etc/os-release not found. Cannot determine OS. Install Docker manually."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "Docker is already installed."
fi

# Verify Docker daemon is running
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Docker daemon is not running. Starting Docker..."
    sudo systemctl start docker
    # Wait a few seconds for daemon to become ready
    sleep 5
    docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Failed to start Docker daemon."; exit 1; }
fi
echo "Docker is ready."

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Install 'act' (GitHub Actions runner for local testing)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v act >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Installing 'act'..."
    ACT_VERSION="v0.2.57"   # Update as needed
    OS=$(uname | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
    ARCH=$(uname -m)
    case "$ARCH" in
        x86_64) ARCH="amd64" ;;
        aarch64|arm64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
        *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
    curl -sSL "https://github.com/nektos/act/releases/download/${ACT_VERSION}/act_${OS}_${ARCH}.tar.gz" -o "$TMP_DIR/act.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$TMP_DIR/act.tar.gz" -C "$TMP_DIR"
    sudo mv "$TMP_DIR/act" /usr/local/bin/act
    sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/act
    rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"
    echo "'act' installed at $(which act)"
else
    echo "'act' is already installed at $(which act)"
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Verify that a GitHub Actions workflow exists
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ ! -d .github/workflows ]]; then
    echo "No .github/workflows directory found in the current repository."
    echo "Please ensure you are running this script at the root of a repo that contains a workflow."
    exit 1
fi

# List available workflows (for debugging)
echo "Available workflows:"
act -l || true

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Run the workflow locally with 'act'
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Use the default event (push) and the default container image (ubuntu-latest)
echo "Running 'act' to execute the workflow locally..."
# The -vv flag provides verbose logs; adjust as needed.
act -vv

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. End of script
# ------------------------------------------------------------
echo "Local execution of GitHub Actions workflow finished."

[RUN] bash work/install_and_test_act.sh

[RESULT_CHECK] 命令输出包含 "Docker is ready."、"act' installed"（或已存在）以及 "Running 'act' to execute the workflow locally..." 并且在最终日志中出现 "All jobs completed" 或 "Job succeeded"（表示 workflow 在本地成功运行）。如果出现 "Job failed" 或类似错误，则说明本地执行未通过。
